statements.proposition: The change (Rollup to Vite build migration) introduces no breaking changes to the package's public API.
statements.label: CANNOT_TELL
statements.note: Source files under src/ are untouched and the package.json exports map and main/module fields are unchanged, which points to no JS API change. But the build output changed (ES/CJS outputs are no longer terser-minified, dist/types.d.ts is no longer produced, shared chunks are possible, the build:dev script was removed). Whether these count as breaking, or whether the built dist is equivalent, was not settled; no build/diff of dist was done.
evidence: pulls/4215/files: 6 files only (package.json, rollup.config.js removed, scripts/build.mjs added, tsconfig.json, vite.config.ts added, yarn.lock); nothing under src/
package.json diff touches only scripts and devDependencies; exports/main/types fields unchanged
Base rollup.config.js emitted dist/types.d.ts and terser-minified wavesurfer.esm.js/.cjs; new scripts/build.mjs sets minify:false for ES/CJS and has no types.d.ts output
